sprint: Image Studio gains the full Draw Your Own stack — freehand strokes in four media (Crayon/Pastel/Brush/Spray), the colour kit, three thicknesses, and real shapes with fill + outline — by REUSING Studio's already-shipped doodle and shape functions rather than authoring a second implementation, exactly as the product owner framed it: "we already have a draw your own functionality in studio why cant we add that into image studio ?"
task: js/cardDesigner.js exports four already-pure helpers on its own api (DOODLE_MEDIA, drawDoodleStroke, buildShapeSilhouettePath, shapeLetterChar, padLetterFont) — none of its own pads/panels change, and drawDoodleStroke was already state-free and deterministic, so the join needed no refactor. js/pictureStudio.js stores the drawing as VECTOR data on _state.doodle in coordinates FRACTIONAL to the source image (strokes {points,color,width,medium}, shapes {shape,x,y,w,h,fill,fillOn,stroke,strokeOn,strokeW}), assigned in open() rather than DEFAULT_STATE — Object.assign copies an array by reference, so a doodle:[] in DEFAULT_STATE would have been the same array for every session and one picture's drawing would bleed into the next. One shared _paintDoodleLayer is called immediately after the drawImage in BOTH _paintOne (preview) and _bake (output), INSIDE the same already-applied translate/rotate/flip transform — so pan/zoom/rotation/flip/fit-scaling all apply to the drawing automatically and preview and output structurally cannot disagree. It clips to the picture rect (nothing paints onto the stage) and resets ctx.filter (Enhance belongs to the photograph, not the child's drawing). A new _screenToImageFraction genuinely inverts translate -> rotate -> flip, unlike _screenToContent which only ever runs post-bg-removal and so deliberately ignores both. Keep This (crop) remaps every fraction onto the new frame and snapshots the layer so Undo Trim restores the drawing too; Trash It leaves dimensions unchanged and needs no remap. Shapes place by drag (a plain tap stamps a comfortable default size) and outline width stays uniform via a DOMMatrix-transformed Path2D rather than a scaled context. Verified 26/26: the Draw tile + contextual collapse + Back/Done + retitled hint; all four media genuinely paint (Spray checked by region, since its scatter can legitimately miss an exact pixel probe) and render distinctly; a stroke lands under the pointer, and still does after a 90-degree turn; shapes stamp a real filled silhouette; Undo/Clear; and the baked output carries the drawing.
